question: Albert invested an amount of Rs. 6000 in a fixed deposit scheme for 3 years at a compound interest rate of 5% p.a. How much will Albert get on maturity of the fixed deposit?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate for 3 years at 5% p.a. = 3R . 3R² | R³ = 15.7625%.

Total amount at maturity = Principal (100%) + CI (15.7625%) = 115.7625%.

Amount = 115.7625% of 6000

Amount = 1.157625 × 6000 = 6945.75

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 6945.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 6000

Rate (R) = 5% p.a.

Time (n) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ
